headline: Cloud infrastructure surges while profits and margins slip
summary_short: Akamai Q3 revenue of $1.122B rose 6% y/y, led by cloud infrastructure services up 34% to $109M. Non-GAAP EPS of $1.77 fell 5% and non-GAAP operating margin dropped to 25%.
summary_long: Security revenue grew 9% to $622M while delivery and other cloud applications fell 3% to $391M. GAAP operating income was $109M, down 35%. Capex reached $464M, 41% of revenue, and cash plus securities stood at $4.24B. Management guided Q4 revenue to $1,145-1,170M and non-GAAP EPS to $1.50-$1.70, and projected 2027 total revenue growth of 17%-22% at constant currency and 2028 revenue above $7.0B.
confidence_notes: Revenue delta computed from $1.122B vs $1.055B reported. Capex is the company's accrual-basis non-GAAP measure and differs from cash-flow purchases. Guidance is stated in the summary text only; it was not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: The CEO cited momentum in cloud infrastructure, with more than $14 billion of multi-year commitments signed so far this year.
Non-GAAP income from operations fell 11% on a 6-point lower margin while revenue rose 6%.
Management expects cloud infrastructure momentum and a strong pipeline to accelerate total revenue growth to 17%-22% in 2027.
